answer.reason: The verses tell at length of Jehu's deeds after his anointing, and the chief ones add to what the summary says.

clauses.english: killed Joram with an arrow shot from his bow
clauses.quote: Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms

clauses.english: killed all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel
clauses.quote: Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel

clauses.english: had all the worshippers of Baal slain in the house of Baal
clauses.quote: Go in, and slay them; let none come forth.

doubts: Verses 2KI 12:1, 2KI 13:1, 2KI 14:8, 2CH 25:17, 2KI 15:12 and HOS 1:4 mention Jehu only as an ancestor or a dating reference, so I left them out.
Jezebel's death at Jehu's word (2KI 9:33) and the killing of Ahaziah's brethren (2KI 10:14) were left out to keep to the chief deeds; Ahaziah's killing is already in the summary.
